narr: Line of thunderstorms moved across the Coastal Bend during the early morning producing locally heavy rainfall. Rainfall amounts between 3 to 4 inches over San Patricio County produced flooding of roads near Odem, Sinton, and Taft.
ev: Texas Department of Transportation reported Farm to Market Road 1944 was closed due to flooding.
Texas Department of Transportation reported water over the road on Farm to Market Road 1945 west of Sinton.
Texas Department of Transportation reported State Highway 188 was down to one lane due to high water over the roadway between U. S. Highway 181 and Farm to Market Road 631.
lsr: TXDOT REPORTS FM 1944 CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING.
